additional_info.subject: ID0400630-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / PN 170000041] Outlet 1 out of order CRM:01811000595
additional_info.body:
Hello Simen,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
Kople AS
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / N0 170000041
Charger ID/Serial No.:
YcY8qS
Problem Description: Outlet 1out of order
We have analyzed the charger and identified an issue related to the fast shutdown wiring, which appears to be causing the converter error E:52. This error is user-generated and suggests a failure in the fast shutdown check. To address this, need to schedule a site intervention to carry out the following checks:
Examine the Fast Shutdown Wiring
: Check he wiring connected to the fast shutdown.
Check KF13 Voltage Output:
Check if the KF13 is sending a steady 12VDC output as required.please bring a spare KF13 for replacement.
MLFB No. 8EM5903-0AA00-6AA1 -KF13
Verifie QA (contactors) Switch Functionality
: After confirming that the KF13 was sending 12V, check whether the QAs are closing correctly.
Check Terminal Connections:
Inspect the connection on the +F03-XD6 terminal.
Verify the connections on XD14.1A/B.
Ensure proper connections on +F03 XD5 for the 12VDC supply.
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since 2nd Dec 2024, as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it
